g.text: ADD COMPLEXITY ONLY WHEN SIMPLER SOLUTIONS FALL SHORT
Erik S. and Barry Zhang · 19 December 2024
“Success in the LLM space isn't about building the most
sophisticated system. It's about building the right system
for your needs. Start with simple prompts, optimize them with
comprehensive evaluation, and add multi-step agentic systems
only when simpler solutions fall short.”
Diagrams redrawn. Not affiliated with, or endorsed by, Anthropic.
